entities.name: Fiero Vespin
entities.description: An ostentatious art dealer and member of the Maestros family in New Capenna, killed after his schemes.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: A character tasked with eliminating Fiero Vespin.

entities.name: Errant
entities.description: One of the couple whose wedding Fiero tried to sabotage.

entities.description: One of the couple whose wedding Fiero tried to sabotage.
